_doc: Bottle geometry for the DR collection (sim/bottle_mesh.py), kept OUT of sim/dr_config.json so a cup run never replays cup trajectories with a bottle: scripts/dr_collect.py --objects sim/dr_objects_bottle.json replaces objects.geometry (and physics_replay.expected_config when given) in the work dir's copy of the config. 2026-11-11, Boyu + Claude.
_status: MEASURED IN PART (2026-11-11). The real bottle is 御茶園 特撰冰釀綠茶 590ml [Boyu]; the shop pages (momo, PChome, uni-prosperity) list only the volume, and a 550 ml variant of the same line exists, do not mix. Sizes are Boyu's measurements (see bottle_ref._source); waist position, foot rounding, mass and friction are still 未確認.
_not_done: physics_replay's config check (dr_collect 'check' step) runs the default paper-cup asset, not these objects, so it says nothing about the bottle; a bottle expected_config needs one run on the 4090 first. dr_render.py textures are the cup's (printed_paper etc.) mapped on the outer surface. Standing bottles only: the 11 tipped demos (object_orientation lying) need an orientation input physics_replay does not have.

geometry._source: Boyu measured 2026-11-11 (ruler / tape, 'about'): height 23 cm with cap; body circumference 21.8 cm -> dia 6.939 (circumference / pi); waist circumference 18.4 cm -> dia 5.857, WAIST HEIGHT RANGE NOT GIVEN YET so no waist in the model; base dia 6.3; shoulder starts 18.2, neck starts 20.7; neck dia 3.0, cap dia 2.8; cap bottom at 21.5 -> cap_h 1.5 (AI's reading of the answer, to confirm). Empty, cap on [Boyu]. Still 未確認: base_h (foot rounding), shell_mass + cap_mass (not weighed), mu_s / mu_d. Sanity: solid volume 753 ml without the waist (~720 with it) vs the 590 ml label -> some part may be modelled too fat or too long; not resolved.
